# Elder Kings 2 compatibility patch — plan

**Status:** steps 1–5 are implemented (commits `5b7f725` and `0c986ba`): detection and guards in the main mod, vanilla data split into replaceable files, and the compatch in `compat/ek2/`, generated by `tools/gen_ek2_compatch.py`. Still open: the load test (steps 0 and 6) and release (step 7). The survey below is the original analysis, kept as the record of why each piece exists.

Survey date: 2026-10-25. EK2 0.21.1 (workshop 2887120253, `supported_version="1.20.1.2"`) against UCM on
`spec/unified-cheat-menu` at `11b3faf` (after the upstream simplification pass). Static survey only (scratch scripts, not kept in the repo);
step 0's load test is still to do.

## What the survey found

EK2 targets the same CK3 version (1.20.1.2), so no version gap. It `replace_path`s cultures, faiths,
religions, doctrines, holy sites, landed titles, dynasties and all history. Vanilla traits, men-at-arms
(MAA), laws and buildings are mostly kept and extended.

| Area | Under EK2 | Severity |
|---|---|---|
| `gui/window_character.gui` | EK2 also ships it (149 changed lines vs vanilla: arcana, praxis, important characters, modifier layout). UCM changes 409 lines. Whichever loads last wipes the other. | **Blocker** |
| `gui/frontend_ingame_menu.gui`, `gui/interaction_menu_window.gui` | EK2 keeps vanilla, so UCM's override still works | OK |
| Hardcoded cultures | ~250 vanilla cultures; **none** exist in EK2 (EK2 has 100). Files: `events/old_char_editor.txt` (228), `events/ucm_cast_culture_faith_generated.txt` (242), `events/ucm_char_design_events.txt` (184), `common/scripted_effects/ucm_acm_culture_list_effects.txt` (143), `events/ucm_culture_taxonomy_events.txt` (143), `events/ucm_beauty_companion_classified_generated.txt` (108) | High: load errors + broken pickers |
| Hardcoded faiths/religions | 78 faiths, 49 religions; none exist (EK2 has 73 faiths in `faith_types`, 36 religions). Same files plus `ucm_acm_faith_editor_data_effects.txt` | High |
| Doctrines | 3,120 used, only 14 missing (Abrahamic/Sinitic/Eastern/pagan hostility, Muhammad succession, temple authority, Zoroastrian branches). EK2 keeps vanilla doctrine keys. `ucm_force_marry_religion.txt` uses one missing hostility doctrine | Medium |
| Titles | 24 missing: `h_china`, `h_roman_empire`, the Mongol/Horde/Yuan empires, `e_france`, `e_spain`, `e_britannia`, `k_england`... in `ucm_legend_master_effects.txt`, `rse_vanilla_overrides.txt`, `zzz_ucm_sand_spawn_maa_fix.txt`, `old_paradox_kludges.txt`, the compat probe, the China safety triggers | Medium |
| Scripted effects EK2 removes | 119 vanilla historical-artifact effects (`create_artifact_excalibur_effect`...) are gone; all are called from `common/decisions/old_decisions.txt` (12 decisions). Triggers, script values, modifiers: 0 hits | Medium |
| Duplicate keys (both mods define them) | 56 character interactions (EK2 `00_debug_interactions.txt` vs UCM `99_ucm_interactions_modified.txt`), 5 gender laws (`rse_gender_laws.txt` vs EK2 `00_succession_laws.txt`), 7 succession/marriage triggers (`rse_vanilla_overrides.txt`), 3 vassal-contract script values | Medium: EK2's edits to those keys may be lost; needs a per-key diff |
| MAA | All 13 UCM-referenced types exist. EK2 adds 202 types the generated MAA catalog doesn't list | Low (feature gap) |
| Buildings | 179 vanilla special buildings referenced by UCM catalogs don't exist; EK2's own buildings aren't listed | Low-medium |
| Traits | Runtime trait lists pick up EK2's 585 traits automatically. 8 refs missing (`eunuch`, `maester`, `nightswatch`, `physician_3`...), but they are missing in vanilla too, so it's not an EK2 problem | Low |

What the static survey can't see: runtime breakage inside EK2's own systems (vampirism/lycanthropy
story cycles, arcana) when the cheat menu sets traits or stats directly, plus any error-log noise from
parse order. A load test (step 0) is the source of truth.

## Approach

Follow the existing AGOT pattern (`ucm_compat_agot_loaded_trigger`, `zzz_ucm_compat_probe.txt`,
`gen_cw_tradition_picker_lists.py --agot-dir`):

- **Main mod**: detect EK2 at game start, gate vanilla-map features, and move hardcoded vanilla data into
  data-only files. This also helps any other total conversion.
- **Separate compatch mod** ("UCM – Elder Kings 2 Compatch", loads after both): the merged
  character window, EK2 versions of the data-only files, and merged duplicate keys.

Why not just gate everything in the main mod: a `culture:roman` reference to a missing object logs an
error at load time and can rewrite the surrounding trigger logic (see the TGP note in
`ucm_compat_triggers.txt`). Runtime gating stops broken behavior but not the load errors. Only
replacing the file removes the errors.

## Steps

### 0. Baseline
1. Static survey re-run at `11b3faf`: numbers above are current.
2. Load test: EK2 alone on 1.20.1.2 and save `error.log` as the baseline. Then EK2 + UCM and diff the logs.
   The diff is the real work list. Note the playset order (UCM after EK2).

### 1. Detection (main mod) — done
- `zzz_ucm_compat_probe.txt`: `exists = title:h_tamriel` sets `ucm_compat_ek2_loaded`.
- `ucm_compat_triggers.txt`: `ucm_compat_ek2_loaded_trigger`.

### 2. Guard vanilla-map features (main mod) — done
The bug class that matters: a missing `title:`/`faith:`/doctrine key is dropped at load, so a `limit`
or `is_shown` holding only that check becomes empty, which counts as **true**. Fixed:
- `zzz_ucm_sand_spawn_maa_fix.txt`: the China/Liao branches would spawn MAA on a missing title →
  `ucm_is_h_china_emperor_title_holder_trigger` / `exists = title:e_great_liao`.
- `99_ucm_interactions_modified.txt`: dynastic-cycle interaction shown to everyone → same China trigger.
- `old_paradox_kludges.txt`: keeper-of-swans / chief-qadi aptitude granted to everyone → `exists` guards.
- `99_ucm_consolidated.txt`: Crusade/Jihad interactions shown but inert → `exists = faith:...`.
- `old_debug_interactions.txt`: Adamite convert → `exists = faith:adamites`.
- `ucm_legend_master_events.txt`: seed-legends page (vanilla characters/titles/cultures) hidden under EK2 and AGOT.
- `ucm_acm_faith_editor_data_effects.txt`: Toric virtue display gated on EK2. Superseded: `tools/gen_faith_editor.py`
  now generates this file, and the compatch ships its own copy built from EK2's databases.

Left alone on purpose:
- `old_decisions.txt` is **one** decision (`Artifact_1000`) with 119 calls, not 12. Missing effects
  are just dropped, so gating them changes nothing. Its books, equipment and banners still work.
- `rse_vanilla_overrides.txt` Mongol `OR` lists: a dropped entry in an `OR` is harmless.
- Faith-editor `remove_doctrine` blocks and `flag:` keys: they collapse to empty or are plain strings.
- `ucm_force_marry_religion.txt` (`pagan_hostility_doctrine`): no hostility doctrine exists in both games → compatch step 4.4.

### 3. Isolate vanilla data (main mod) — done
Every vanilla-only data block now sits in its own file, which the compatch replaces at the same path:

| Main-mod file (vanilla data) | Moved from | EK2 compatch version |
|---|---|---|
| `events/old_char_editor_culture_faith.txt` | `old_char_editor.39`–`.42` | stub pages that go back to `.1000`; the entries in `.1000` are hidden under EK2 |
| `events/ucm_char_design_culture_faith.txt` | `sarc_char_design.1051`–`.1054` | stub pages that go back to `.9999`; the hub options are hidden under EK2 (the new character keeps root's culture/faith) |
| `common/scripted_triggers/ucm_acm_culture_region_triggers.txt` | region whitelists in `ucm_acm_culture_list_effects.txt` | `always = no` (the picker only ever shows "all") |
| `common/scripted_effects/ucm_acm_faith_editor_data_effects.txt` | (whole file) | generated from EK2's doctrine, tenet and religion databases |
| `common/scripted_effects/old_historical_relics_effects.txt` | sections 1/1B of `Artifact_1000` | generated: keeps the 14 relics EK2 still defines |

These legacy menus keep their files, and under EK2 their entry points in `ucm_cheat_menu_events.txt` open the runtime
culture picker (`ucm_open_acm_culture_picker_effect`):
- `ucm_cast_culture_faith_generated.txt` (`.0021`)
- `ucm_culture_taxonomy_events.txt` (`.0120`, `.0130`)

The beauty-companion culture option (`.0180`) is hidden instead. The compatch ships stubs of all three files (only the
event IDs referenced from outside them), so they log no load errors.

The religion virtue/sin data is now generated from the game files. That also fixes three stale vanilla entries:
`violet_poet` (Germanic), `gregarious` (Hellenism), and Islam's `deceitful` replacing `arbitrary`.

### 4. Compatch mod — done (`compat/ek2/`)
- `descriptor.mod`: depends on Elder Kings 2 and Unified Cheat Menu, and must load after both.
- Generated by `tools/gen_ek2_compatch.py`. Rerun it after any CK3, EK2 or UCM update; it stops on merge conflicts.
  - `gui/window_character.gui`: 3-way merge (base vanilla) with no conflicts. EK2's arcana/praxis/important-characters panels and UCM's hooks are both kept.
  - `common/laws/rse_gender_laws.txt` and `common/scripted_triggers/rse_vanilla_overrides.txt`: UCM files with the 4
    blocks EK2 changed 3-way merged. These are EK2's `male_only_law` / `male_preference_law` `should_start_with`
    and the partition triggers without the Mongol titles. The other 68 keys both mods define are identical in EK2
    and vanilla, so they need nothing.
  - `common/religion/religion_types/ucm_force_marry_religion.txt`: `rf_aurbis` + `aurbic_hostility_doctrine`.
  - The religion virtues/sins and relic files from step 3.
- Hand-written: the event stubs and the region triggers from step 3.
- Not done (optional): MAA / building / artifact catalogs that list EK2 content. The pickers still work, but EK2's
  202 MAA types and its buildings aren't offered.

### 5. EK2 systems review — done, nothing to fix
The trait editor uses a fixed list of about 300 vanilla trait IDs, so it can't reach EK2's vampire, lycan, lich,
arcana or Daedric traits. EK2 grants those through effects such as `give_vampire_secret_or_trait_effect` and
`give_lich_trait_effect`, which set flags, secrets, decay and lifespan along with the trait.

The trait guard only strips UCM's own traits. The stat lock doesn't touch arcana, which is stored as `var:arcana_base`.

The only overlap is the illness purge (Baidubuqin / water of life). It also cures EK2's `sanguinare_vampiris`, the
same way EK2's own cure does.

If the trait list is ever regenerated to include EK2 traits, route those three groups through EK2's effects in
`ucm_trait_editor_toggle_effect`.

Known leftovers (load-log lines only, behaviour already guarded):
- `ucm_legend_master_effects.txt`: seed legends; their menu page is hidden under EK2.
- `99_ucm_consolidated.txt`: the Crusade/Jihad interactions, guarded with `exists`.
- `005_zhuge_qita_decisions.txt` and the water-of-life template/event: characters are created with
  `culture:roman` / `faith:orthodox` etc., so under EK2 those lines are dropped and the defaults apply.
- `exists = title:...` guards in the sand MAA fix, kludges, China safety triggers and the compat probe.

### 6. Verify
- Load test EK2 + UCM + compatch. `error.log` should show no new errors over the EK2-alone baseline.
- Smoke test in a game started from an EK2 bookmark: main menu, character window (EK2 panels and UCM
  buttons both present), culture/faith pickers, faith editor, MAA spawn, artifacts, succession menu.
- Save, reload, play a few years at speed 5.

### 7. Release
- Check EK2's terms before publishing. The merged `window_character.gui` contains EK2's GUI code, so it
  needs their permission (their repo/credits have no license file in the workshop copy).
- Workshop item with required-items links to UCM and EK2. Credits per spec §9.4.
- Note in the description that the compatch must be re-merged after EK2 updates that touch
  the character window. The data files just need the generators re-run.

## Size

- Steps 1–2: small, a few files.
- Step 3: the largest UCM-side change, ~6 files, mostly mechanical.
- Step 4.2 (GUI merge): the riskiest piece, redone on EK2 GUI updates.
- Step 4.5: depends on the per-key diff, unknown until done.

A minimal first release is steps 0–2 + 4.1–4.2 + 6. It's playable, with vanilla-only pickers hidden
under EK2. The EK2 culture/faith pickers and catalogs come after that.
